question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He is greatly loved by all for his ________ nature.
solution:
The correct answer is '**compassionate**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**compassionate**'.
 
• It means 'feeling or showing sympathy and concern for others'. (दूसरों के लिए सहानुभूति और चिंता महसूस करना या दिखाना)
 
 
• *Example: I allowed him to go home on **compassionate** grounds.*
